sheets.prompt: Surface design sheet for a science fiction exploration game, the pale stone buildings of a quiet lamp-lit town in a misty wetland: walls, terrace columns and steps of pale bone-white and ash-grey limestone laid in large soft-edged blocks of slightly different tones, rounded worn arrises, fine vertical rain streaks below sills and cornices, a darker damp band at the foot of the walls, a few hairline cracks, sparse pitting, an occasional block replaced with a warmer one. Three panels side by side: a large square-on swatch of the wall; a terrace hall of this stone seen from a walker's height in soft mist with a small figure and a hanging lamp for scale; a strip showing the marks simplifying with distance, block joints and the damp band staying, cracks and pits gone far. Calm, quiet, flat colour dominant, marks sparse and fine. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, bone white, ash grey, a little lavender in the shadows and a warm lamp glow, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, photo texture, text, watermark, lettering, labels, moss, vines.
